source: import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const context=readFileSync('/proc/self/attr/current','utf8').replace(/\0/g,'').trim(); const status=readFileSync('/proc/self/status','utf8'); if (process.getuid()!==Number(process.env.PROBE_UID) || !/^u:r:untrusted_app/.test(context) || !/^Seccomp:\s+2$/m.test(status)) throw new Error('not an app seccomp domain'); console.log(JSON.stringify({uid:process.getuid(),context,seccomp:2,arch:process.arch,version:Bun.version}));
console.log('JavaScript 中文 😀 '+Bun.version); console.error('stderr-ok'); await Promise.resolve();

import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; writeFileSync('child.js',"console.log('child-ok');console.error('child-stderr');"); const args=[process.execPath,'run','--no-install',process.cwd()+'/child.js']; const sync=Bun.spawnSync(args,{stdout:'pipe',stderr:'pipe'}); if(sync.exitCode!==0 || !sync.stdout.toString().includes('child-ok') || !sync.stderr.toString().includes('child-stderr')) throw new Error('spawnSync failed'); const child=Bun.spawn(args,{stdout:'pipe',stderr:'pipe'}); const [out,err,exit]=await Promise.all([new Response(child.stdout).text(),new Response(child.stderr).text(),child.exited]); if(exit!==0 || !out.includes('child-ok') || !err.includes('child-stderr')) throw new Error('spawn failed'); console.log('spawn+spawnSync-ok');

import { writeFile,readFile,copyFile,rename,unlink } from 'node:fs/promises'; await writeFile('input.txt','file-中文'); await copyFile('input.txt','copy.txt'); await rename('copy.txt','moved.txt'); if(await readFile('moved.txt','utf8')!=='file-中文') throw new Error('file content drift'); await unlink('input.txt'); await unlink('moved.txt'); console.log('file-io-ok');

const server=Bun.serve({hostname:'127.0.0.1',port:0,fetch(){return new Response('fetch-ok');}}); try {const response=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+server.port+'/probe'); if(response.status!==200 || await response.text()!=='fetch-ok') throw new Error('fetch failed'); console.log('fetch-loopback-ok');} finally {server.stop(true);}

let received=0; process.on('SIGSYS',()=>received++); process.kill(process.pid,'SIGSYS'); await Bun.sleep(250); if(received!==1) throw new Error('ordinary SIGSYS not delivered'); console.log('user-sigsys-ok');
